# Pot Duplication Datapack

Turn ordinary decorated pots into powerful duplication machines!

Simply place an item into a decorated pot, and instead of storing it, the pot instantly duplicates the item, giving you an extra copy. Whether you're duplicating diamonds, building materials, food, or rare treasures, this datapack adds a fun and overpowered twist to survival gameplay.

## Features

* Duplicate almost any item by inserting it into a decorated pot.
* Works instantly with a simple and intuitive mechanic.
* Perfect for creative worlds, challenge runs, and chaotic multiplayer servers.
* Lightweight and easy to install.
* Designed for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.x.

Can you resist the temptation of unlimited resources, or will the power of infinite items consume your world?
